follow_up_questions.question: Do you feel a persistent sensation of needing to pass stool (tenesmus) even when little or nothing comes out?
follow_up_questions.quoted_excerpt: Patient: Yeah. I mean I, it, I feel, I feel a cramp. and then, and then I know it's time to go right? So, around every hour I just feel something come up. And then I have to go.
follow_up_questions.reasoning: Tenesmus is a feature of rectal inflammation/proctitis or distal colitis (e.g., bacterial pathogens, IBD, sexually transmitted proctitis) and would point away from uncomplicated small-bowel viral gastroenteritis.
